svg.title: How often each gap appeared
svg.desc: Documented gaps across 30 reviewed attempts. Implementation errors: 21; Poor resource management: 20; Poor time management: 15; Misinterpreting results: 13; Poor experiment tracking and reproducibility: 9; Delivery failures and task violations: 7; Poor experiment design: 6; Insufficient validation: 6; Insufficient problem exploration: 5; Information leakage: 2. Categories overlap and include repaired errors. Resource management includes one strongly supported inference.
